title: M-MAD: Multidimensional Multi-Agent Debate for Advanced Machine Translation Evaluation

title: Problem
问题
html: LLM judges for machine translation still trail learned metrics and a single holistic prompt obscures why a translation is good or bad. M-MAD replaces that single judgement with a structured multi-agent evaluation framework. Human MQM annotation is expensive, while learned metrics often need references and training data; single-agent LLM judges have weak segment-level correlation, coupled error templates, and unstable attribution. Thus a system-level-looking score may not support sentence-level diagnosis or auditable error reasons. Existing approaches also mix accuracy, fluency, style, and terminology in one template, allowing salient error types to dominate a total score. The authors therefore separate finding an error from synthesizing quality so a final verdict can point back to evidence.

机器翻译中的 LLM 评审仍落后于学习式指标，单一整体提示也难解释译文在哪些方面优劣。M-MAD 以结构化多智能体评测取代单次判断。 WMT 的人工 MQM 细粒度标注昂贵，学习式指标通常还依赖参考译文与训练数据；现有单智能体 LLM judge 则在片段级相关性、耦合错误模板和判断偏差上受限。这个缺口使系统级看似可靠的指标难以支持逐句诊断和可复核的错误归因。 现有方法还把准确性、流畅性、风格和术语混在同一模板中，容易让显著的错误类别主导总分，掩盖其余维度。作者因此把“发现何种错误”和“综合质量”分离，以便让最终判决能回指到具体证据。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: M-MAD decomposes MQM-inspired criteria into dimensions, lets judge agents debate within each dimension, and asks a final agent to synthesize the verdict. The released repository contains prompts, WMT-23 inputs, annotated outputs, and meta-evaluation materials. Its evaluation object is a source, translation, dimension-level error spans and severities, debate viewpoints, and final score—not preference-training data. The repository uses WMT-23 Metrics Shared Task inputs and preserves stage prompts and outputs, enabling a reader to trace why a total score was produced. It does not train a new reward model: each stage calls an existing LLM and uses MQM error category and severity as an explicit contract. It is therefore an evaluation recipe, not general supervision data inferred from the reported correlations.

M-MAD 将 MQM 启发的准则拆成多个维度，让评审智能体在每个维度内辩论，再由最终智能体综合判决。官方仓库发布提示词、WMT-23 输入、标注输出和元评测材料。 其数据对象是源文、译文、按维度产生的错误跨度与严重度、辩论观点及最终分数，而非用于训练的偏好数据。仓库的输入来自 WMT-23 Metrics Shared Task，并保留各阶段的提示词与输出，使读者能够追溯总分为何产生。 它不训练新的奖励模型：各阶段均调用现成 LLM，并以 MQM 的错误类别和严重度作为显式判断契约。因而读者可把它用于评测配方，而不能把表中相关性直接理解为已得到通用监督数据。

title: Method
方法
html:
1. For each source–translation pair, M-MAD splits MQM into four dimensions: accuracy, fluency, style, and terminology.
  1. A dimension-specific agent marks error spans, subcategories, and severity. Two agents then conduct a pro–con debate for that dimension; a consensus checker stops it when they agree, otherwise the initial supportive side is retained after the round limit.
  1. A final judge removes redundancy, synthesizes all four viewpoints, and calculates the MQM score with major/minor weights 5 and 1. Experiments use GPT-4o mini, temperature 0, four WMT-22 MQM demonstrations, and WMT-23 data.

1. 对每个源文—译文对，M-MAD 将 MQM 拆为准确性、流畅性、风格和术语四个维度。
  1. 维度专属智能体标记错误跨度、子类和严重度；随后两名智能体在该维度进行正反辩论。共识检查器在达成一致时停止；超过轮数仍无共识，则保留初始判断的支持方。
  1. 最终评审器去冗余、综合四个观点，并以 major/minor 权重 5 和 1 计算 MQM 分数。实验使用 GPT-4o mini、温度 0、四个 WMT-22 MQM 示例和 WMT-23 数据。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The decisive controlled comparison uses WMT-23 MQM ratings: 45 systems, 68,130 segments, four languages, and EN–DE, ZH–EN, HE–EN evaluation, with GPT-4o mini and temperature 0 for all LLM judges. On ZH–EN/EN–DE, M-MAD’s meta score is 0.814/0.577 versus GEMBA-MQM’s 0.784/0.475; Table 3 shows removing dimension partition hurts the ZH–EN meta score by 0.041, far more than removing debate (0.006). This supports the configuration and especially dimension partition, not a general guarantee for other models or languages.

决定性对比使用 WMT-23 MQM 标注：45 个系统、68,130 个片段、四种语言，并评测 EN–DE、ZH–EN、HE–EN；所有 LLM 评审器均用 GPT-4o mini、温度 0。在 ZH–EN/EN–DE 上，M-MAD 的 meta 分数为 0.814/0.577，GEMBA-MQM 为 0.784/0.475；表 3 显示去掉维度拆分使 ZH–EN meta 下降 0.041，远大于去掉辩论的 0.006。这支持该配置，尤其是维度拆分，不能保证对其他模型或语种同样成立。

title: Novelty
新意
html: Earlier LLM judging typically uses one prompt and one model decision. M-MAD changes the decision granularity: MQM criteria are split before agents debate, then a separate agent synthesizes them. Multi-agent debate alone is not new; the contribution is its dimension-conditioned integration for MT evaluation. Relative to GEMBA-MQM and EAPrompt, which also use MQM prompting, it does not merely place more labels into one generation. It decouples dimensions first, preserves conflicting stances in debate, and only then converts evidence into a weighted score; the changed object is where evidence is aggregated.

既有 LLM 评测常用一个提示和一次模型判断。M-MAD 改变决策粒度：先拆分 MQM 维度，再在维度内辩论，最后由独立智能体综合。多智能体辩论本身并非新颖，贡献在于其面向机器翻译的维度条件化整合。 与 GEMBA-MQM、EAPrompt 同用 MQM 提示的最近做法相比，它不是把更多错误标签塞入同一次生成，而是先解除维度耦合，再把立场冲突保留到辩论阶段，最后才转成加权分数；因此改变的是证据汇合位置。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The paper’s score depends on MQM’s four selected dimensions and the fixed major/minor weighting; rare non-translation and locale-convention categories are excluded for comparison fairness. If a target error taxonomy differs, the final score changes meaning. Its multi-agent result also incurs API cost and inherits GPT-4o-mini prompt sensitivity; audit both human correlation and per-segment cost before deployment. For Table 4, extracting error spans from two unstructured baselines relies on output-string matching; the authors note this may slightly inflate their scores, so M-MAD’s span advantage is not unbiased. When no consensus occurs, retaining the initial stance can transmit first-round prompt bias into the final judgment.

论文分数依赖 MQM 选定的四个维度及固定的 major/minor 权重；为与基线公平比较，罕见的非翻译和地区惯例类别被排除。目标任务若采用不同错误分类，最终分数的含义会改变。多智能体流程也会增加 API 成本并继承 GPT-4o-mini 的提示敏感性；部署前应审计人工相关性和每片段成本。 表 4 的错误跨度抽取对两种非结构化基线依赖输出字符串匹配，作者承认这可能略微抬高它们的分数；因此 M-MAD 的跨度优势不能被简单视为无偏比较。未达共识时保留初始立场还会把首轮提示偏差传给最终判决。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: An MT evaluation team can run the released three-stage process on system outputs, producing dimension scores and a final judgement for error analysis. Compare its correlation with local human labels against the current metric. Do not use it as the only gate where target-language MQM criteria or judge reliability have not been validated. Supply source text, candidate translation, a target-language MQM taxonomy, and a judge; retain four-dimensional errors and debate history before applying weights. Success is local human-MQM correlation at segment and system level—not agent agreement—and should be compared with a single-prompt baseline under equal budget.

机器翻译团队可对系统输出运行三阶段流程，得到维度分数、总判决和误差分析，再与本地人工标注比较相关性。若目标语种的 MQM 准则或评审可靠性未核验，不应把它作为唯一发布门槛。 复用时应输入源文、候选译文、目标语种的 MQM 分类和评审模型；保存四维错误与辩论历史，再以 major/minor 权重生成报告。成功标准是与本地人工 MQM 的片段级、系统级相关性，而不是智能体一致，并应与单提示基线做等预算对照。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
1. Position: replaces one coupled MQM prompt with four error dimensions.
  1. Mechanism: one initial evaluator, two-agent pro–con debate with consensus stopping, then a synthesizing judge.
  1. Data: WMT-23 MQM has 45 systems and 68,130 segments; WMT-22 supplies four-shot demonstrations.
  1. Evidence: M-MAD is 0.814/0.577 meta on ZH–EN/EN–DE; removing dimension partition costs 0.041 on ZH–EN.
  1. Reuse: retain the taxonomy and score weights, then validate correlation and cost locally.

1. 定位：用四个错误维度取代耦合的单一 MQM 提示。
  1. 机制：初始评审、两智能体正反辩论与共识停止，最后综合。
  1. 数据：WMT-23 MQM 有 45 个系统、68,130 个片段；WMT-22 提供四示例。
  1. 证据：M-MAD 在 ZH–EN/EN–DE 的 meta 为 0.814/0.577；去维度拆分使 ZH–EN 降 0.041。
  1. 复用：保留分类与权重，再本地验证相关性和成本。
